title: 构建失败
description: 构建失败（状态化假 gradlew 首次必败）：失败摘要、日志与 tool_result ok=false 全链路

gradlew.content:
#!/bin/sh
# E2E fake gradlew: fails on the first invocation, succeeds afterwards.
MARKER="app/build/.e2e-built-once"
if [ ! -f "$MARKER" ]; then
  mkdir -p app/build
  touch "$MARKER"
  echo 'FAILURE: Build failed with an exception.'
  echo '* What went wrong:'
  echo "Execution failed for task ':app:checkDebugAarMetadata'."
  echo 'BUILD FAILED in 3s'
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p app/build/outputs/apk/debug
printf 'PK\x03\x04E2E-FAKE-APK' > app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
echo 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 2s'
exit 0

steps.text: 构建失败：checkDebugAarMetadata 任务执行失败，需要修复。
